```{r}
#Loading packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(naniar)
library(DHARMa)
library(gtsummary)
library(broom)
library(moments)
#install.packages("car")
library(car)
#install.packages("lme4", type = "source")
library(lme4)

```

```{r}
#Reading in data
cleaned_seaotter_data <- read_csv(here("Data/cleaned_seaotter_data.csv"))
```

```{r}
#Filtering only usable data
cleaned_seaotter_data1 <- cleaned_seaotter_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(month)) %>% 
  filter(sex_cd == "f" | sex_cd == "m") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(site_name)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(dive_time)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(dive_num)) %>% 
  filter(visibility_cd != "un") %>% 
  filter(ageclass_cd != "u") %>% 
  filter(success_cd == "y" | success_cd == "n") %>% 
  mutate(month = as.factor(month)) %>% 
  mutate(dive_num_factor = as.factor(dive_num)) %>% 
  mutate(ageclass_cd = factor(ageclass_cd, levels = c("j", "s", "a", "o"))) %>% 
  mutate(visibility_cd = factor(visibility_cd, levels = c("po", "fa", "go", "vg", "ex"))) %>% 
  mutate(success_cd = case_when(success_cd == "y" ~ 1,
                                success_cd == "n" ~ 0))

```

```{r}
#Filtered Data, removing juvenile and old age for age class
cleaned_seaotter_data2 <- cleaned_seaotter_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(month)) %>% 
  filter(sex_cd == "f" | sex_cd == "m") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(site_name)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(dive_time)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(dive_num)) %>% 
  filter(visibility_cd != "un") %>% 
  filter(ageclass_cd == "s" | ageclass_cd == "a") %>% 
  filter(success_cd == "y" | success_cd == "n") %>% 
  mutate(month = as.factor(month)) %>% 
  mutate(dive_num_factor = as.factor(dive_num)) %>% 
  mutate(ageclass_cd = factor(ageclass_cd, levels = c("s", "a"))) %>% 
  mutate(visibility_cd = factor(visibility_cd, levels = c("po", "fa", "go", "vg", "ex"))) %>% 
  mutate(success_cd = case_when(success_cd == "y" ~ 1,
                                success_cd == "n" ~ 0))

```


```{r}
#Nested Logistic regression 
success_model1 <- glmer(success_cd ~ month + sex_cd + dive_time + dive_num_factor + ageclass_cd + visibility_cd + (1 | site_name) + (1 | bout_id), data = cleaned_seaotter_data1, family = "binomial")

success_model2 <- glmer(success_cd ~ month + sex_cd + dive_time + dive_num_factor + ageclass_cd + visibility_cd + (1 | site_name), data = cleaned_seaotter_data1, family = "binomial")

success_model_nodivenum <- glmer(success_cd ~ month + sex_cd + dive_time + ageclass_cd + visibility_cd + (1 | site_name), data = cleaned_seaotter_data1, family = "binomial")

success_model_trimageclass <- glmer(success_cd ~ month + sex_cd + dive_time + dive_num_factor + ageclass_cd + visibility_cd + (1 | site_name) + (1 | bout_id), data = cleaned_seaotter_data2, family = "binomial")


unique(cleaned_seaotter_data1$bout_id)

summary(success_model1)
summary(success_model2)
summary(success_model_nodivenum)
summary(success_model_trimageclass)

summary(success_model_nodivenum)
simulateResiduals(success_model1) %>% 
  plot()
simulateResiduals(success_model_nodivenum) %>% 
  plot()

AIC(success_model1, success_model2)
AIC(success_model1, success_model2, success_model_nodivenum, success_model_trimageclass)

```

```{r}
# Explore Model With Best AIC
summary(success_model_trimageclass)

simulateResiduals(success_model_trimageclass) %>%
  plot()

```



```{r}
cleaned_seaotter_data1 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = success_cd)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(~ageclass_cd)

cleaned_seaotter_data1 %>% 
  group_by(ageclass_cd, success_cd) %>% 
  summarize(n = count())

cleaned_seaotter_data1 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dive_time)) +
  geom_histogram()
```


```{r}
#Checking for multicolinearity


#Categorical variables success and sex correlation?
success_sex_data <- table(cleaned_seaotter_data1$success_cd,
                    cleaned_seaotter_data1$sex_cd)

chisq.test(success_sex_data)
#X-squared = 3.9197e-30, df = 1, p-value = 1 --no correlation 


#Dive number & Dive time correlation?
cor.test(
  as.numeric(as.character(cleaned_seaotter_data1$dive_num)),
  cleaned_seaotter_data1$dive_time)
#t = -4.6847, df = 5544, p-value = 2.871e-06



```
